name: STAR Environment — U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 below 86 km
summary: Temperature, pressure, density and speed of sound of the 1976 U.S. Standard Atmosphere at geometric altitude from -5 km to 86 km; reproduces the published tables to the printed digits and refuses altitudes outside the model.
reference: U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976 (NOAA-S/T 76-1562): layer base pressures 22632.06, 5474.889, 868.0187, 110.9063, 66.93887, 3.956420 Pa and main-table rows at 0, 1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 80 km
reference_observed: base pressures within 2e-7 relative; table rows within 0.0005 K and one unit in the fifth printed digit of pressure and density

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: SI units; input is geometric altitude in metres, stated in docstring and README; constants of the 1976 standard pinned in the tests
review.G-06: no external data; the layer table is in the module and pinned by a test
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for invalid input and for altitudes outside the model; no iteration, no extrapolation
